Updated **Linux Settings layout** so that when the selected screen is **Cassette**, the **cassette variant** control (“variant” row) appears **immediately below** the **screen** setting.

- Code change: `lib/widgets/void_settings_sheet.dart`
  - On **Linux**: moved `_Cycle(void-settings-cassette-variant, ...)` to render right after the `_Cycle(void-settings-screen, ...)` row.
  - On **Linux**: removed that same variant row from the later DISPLAY section to avoid duplication.
  - Behavior of the controls (labels + save callbacks) is preserved.

Screenshot (Cassette selected, showing the screen row with variant directly underneath):
![Settings cassette region](.tmp/agent_shots/settings_cassette_region_crop.png)
